text:
A liquid-in-glass thermometer is to be calibrated in degrees Celsius.
Where should the bulb of the thermometer be placed to set a fixed point on the temperature
scale?
A
in a mixture of water and ice
B
in a hot drink
C
in a Bunsen burner flame
D
in a refrigerator

options.label: A
options.text: in a mixture of water and ice
